title: Hurricane Lala strengthens as it heads to Hawaii
script: This is a short news brief with the key details. Reports are focusing on this development: Hurricane Lala strengthens as it heads to Hawaii. In simple words, Hurricane Lala is headed toward Hawaii's Big Island.
